member_group_id.description: Reference to the MemberGroup this decision email belongs to

vacancy_id.description: Reference to the Vacancy the decision relates to

decision_type.description: Whether the email was sent for an approval (award) or a decline decision

source_type.description: Where the applicant came from: a form 'submission' or a legacy express-interest 'application'

source_id.description: Id of the originating form_submission or vacancy_application row

body_html.description: Rich-text (HTML) email body that was sent

sent_by_email.description: Email of the admin who sent the decision email

sent_by_member_id.description: Member id of the admin who sent the decision email, if available

delivery_status.description: Whether the email was accepted by the mail provider

delivery_error.description: Provider error string when delivery failed
